entries.trigger: start, continue, go, pointer, title, handoff, stop
entries.read_before: Before starting or handing off any Action.

entries.trigger: ask, request help, concern, idea, proposal capture, governance, complete, split, draft, preview, settle, workspace, database denied
entries.read_before: Before submitting a request or changing Project state; direct proposal capture needs no implementation Action; use ordinary host permission recovery or preserve a blocked validated Ask.

entries.trigger: operator, picker, runs, grant, approval, script, publish, ping, nudge, notify operator, look at this
entries.read_before: Before preparing any operator step; generating a button never grants execution authority.

entries.trigger: missing capability, unsupported command, Way gap
entries.read_before: Before building a local substitute for Arcadia machinery.

entries.trigger: scope, Pareto, YAGNI, decompose, defer, blocker, defect, issue
entries.read_before: Before choosing scope, deferring work, or capturing a new defect.

entries.trigger: commit, push, pull request, CodeRabbit, CI, merge, notification
entries.read_before: Before any PR operation; retain exact-head review and approval gates.

entries.trigger: first tool, command, subsystem, failure, retry, friction, notes
entries.read_before: Before implementation, repair, validation or handoff and again on a new failure; search Project notes first.

entries.trigger: commit, comment, signature, author, critic, builder
entries.read_before: Before every agent commit or posted comment; resolve identity for the current model.

entries.trigger: Project, Plan, Action, Decision, status, acceptance
entries.read_before: Before preparing a managed-document change; state changes require an Agent Ask.

entries.trigger: new planning cycle, raw outcome, interview, architect
entries.read_before: Before starting a new planning cycle, rather than continuing an Action.

entries.trigger: worktree, branch, preserve, detached, conflict, local only
entries.read_before: Before editing code or reconciling Git, and before stopping.

entries.trigger: peer watch, heartbeat, stalled, exhausted, out of tokens, takeover, released ownership
entries.read_before: Before judging, offering help to or continuing another agent's work; silence never proves release.

entries.trigger: comms, coordination issue, sub-issue, relay, peer sessions
entries.read_before: Before running or briefing a Comms session, or posting to a coordination Issue; a comment is a signal, never authority.

entries.trigger: rehearsal, freeze, production active, reinstall, restart, install, services, go-broker
entries.read_before: Before reinstalling, restarting or fast-forwarding shared host state; while production status is Active the window is open.

entries.trigger: operator-directed, operator asks directly, side track, parallel track, outside the plan, no Action
entries.read_before: Before starting work the operator asked for directly that no queued Action holds; interim guidance that grants no authority and moves no pointer or queue.

entries.trigger: harness, orchestration, new workflow, instruction file, session protocol, inactive work, inactivity ping, file handoff
entries.read_before: Before adding a workflow, instruction file or orchestration, or when a turn would leave claimed work inactive; a standard harness runs unmodified. Grants no authority.

entries.trigger: Ask/To-do scout, Hello World scout, zero-model scout
entries.read_before: Before running or changing the bounded Ask/To-do scout scenario.

entries.trigger: launch subagent, driver brief, session ledger row, model per role
entries.read_before: Before launching or briefing a Session or subagent, or writing a hand-back; grants no authority.

entries.trigger: native app session, direct session, simulate unattended, supervisor, ios app, codex app, opencode app
entries.read_before: Before running a session the operator opened directly in a native coding-agent app; it simulates the unattended Lead and grants no authority.

entries.trigger: hacker mode, repeated refusal, procedural fixation, red alert, stop-the-line, blocked route, supervisor recovery
entries.read_before: Before another unchanged workflow retry; supervisors require bounded diagnosis after two refusals without evidence gain, or immediately on an explicit red alert. Grants no authority.

entries.trigger: code simplification, simplify code, refactoring, maintainability, complexity finding
entries.read_before: Before an assigned simplification or responding to a concrete complexity finding; existing roles and authority only, no automatic cleanup stage.

entries.trigger: continue Scout project, Arcadia Studio Scout, Scout continuation, Scout handoff
entries.read_before: Before resuming the Scout project for Arcadia Studio; verify current records and authority before execution.

entries.trigger: chat title, sidebar, helper arrow, direct contact, question, blocked, parked, retitle
entries.read_before: Before choosing or updating chat titles; display conventions preserve actual parent assignments, custody and approval boundaries.
